name: Fixture Platform Endeavour
description: Exercises pattern orchestration as a layered model: sequenced phases, a parallel track, a sprint repeating inside each phase of a milestone plan, and a pattern reached for on demand.

patterns.name: Bootstrap the Platform
patterns.description: Bringing a shared foundation into existence for the first time.

patternViews.name: Agree the Need
patternViews.description: Establish that a shared foundation is worth building.

narrativeContexts.context: Every team builds its own foundation and the duplication is visible.

patternViews.name: Stand It Up
patternViews.description: Build the foundation and let a team use it.

narrativeContexts.context: The first golden path is built and proved with a willing team.

patterns.name: Run the Platform
patterns.description: Keeping the foundation healthy once teams depend on it.

patternViews.name: Operate
patternViews.description: Carry production workloads within agreed bounds.

patternViews.name: Improve
patternViews.description: Act on what operating the platform reveals.

loopsBackTo.description: Each improvement returns the platform to normal running.

patterns.name: Milestone Plan
patterns.description: The coarse phases a long-running delivery passes through.

patternViews.name: Foundations
patternViews.description: Put in place what everything later depends on.

patternViews.name: Build Out
patternViews.description: Grow the platform to carry real work.

patternViews.name: Hand Over
patternViews.description: Transfer the platform to the team that will run it.

patterns.name: Sprint
patterns.description: A short increment of work, planned and reviewed within a phase.

patternViews.name: Plan the Increment
patternViews.description: Agree what this increment will deliver.

patternViews.name: Review the Increment
patternViews.description: Judge the increment against what was agreed.

loopsBackTo.description: Each increment feeds the planning of the next.

patterns.name: Security Assurance
patterns.description: Continuous assurance that the platform remains defensible.

patternViews.name: Establish Controls
patternViews.description: Agree the controls the platform must satisfy.

patternViews.name: Verify Controls
patternViews.description: Confirm the controls hold as the platform changes.

patterns.name: Incident Response
patterns.description: Restoring service when something user-visible breaks.

patternViews.name: Contain
patternViews.description: Limit the impact before diagnosing it.

patternViews.name: Restore
patternViews.description: Return the platform to normal running.

patternOrchestrations.name: Platform Endeavour
patternOrchestrations.description: The whole life of a platform: sequenced phases, with assurance alongside, sprints inside each phase, and incident response always available.

exitCriteria.name: Platform is usable
exitCriteria.description: Whether the platform can carry a real workload unaided.
when: a team deploys a production workload to it
then: the workload runs without intervention by the platform team

narrativeContexts.context: Prove a shared foundation is worth having before asking anyone to depend on it.
Teams ship on the shared foundation and the platform team runs it.

exitCriteria.name: Controls hold at hand over
exitCriteria.description: Whether the agreed controls still hold when the platform changes hands.
given: controls were agreed at the start of the plan
when: the platform is handed to the team that will run it
then: every agreed control is verified against the platform as it then stands

exitCriteria.name: Increment accepted
exitCriteria.description: Whether the increment met the phase objective it was serving.
given: a sprint has run to its end
when: the increment is reviewed against the phase objective
then: the increment is accepted or its shortfall carries into the next sprint

trigger.name: Production impact recognised
trigger.description: What the team notices that causes the incident pattern to be run.
given: the platform is carrying production workloads
when: a user-visible failure is recognised by anyone on the team
then: the incident response pattern is entered regardless of the phase in progress
